notes.title: Update notes 22/06/2024
notes.content:
Adjusted and sped up the player's melee attack
 But, also slightly lowered melee attack damage
 Sped up the player's climbing action
 Improved basic ghoul enemy's attack animation
 Various other player animation tweaks


I will now take a break from updates and play Elden RIng: Shadow of the Erdtree. Please understand.

notes.title: Update notes 15/06/2024
notes.content:
Slightly increased the player's run & melee attack speed
 Have tuned some of the later bossfights to be more difficult (more HP, stronger attacks)
 Fixed some small Map issues
 Fixed (again) issue with camera not reverting back to player correctly after story scene
 Added a few extra Tutorial message prompts

notes.title: Update notes
notes.content:
- Split up more enemy sets so corpses fade out more quickly.
- Addressed some issues which should resolve camera not restoring correctly after Piranesi story segments

notes.title: Update notes 25/05/2024
notes.content:
Fixed bug with bosses not resetting properly (in particular final bossfights)
 Fixed bug with being able to use radio to dodge damage and stun enemies
 Turned on Vsync by default (would appreciate feedback in case people would prefer option to turn this off/on)

notes.title: Update 23/05/2024
notes.content:
Added a .exe icon
 Slightly weakened the Ghoul enemies in the first area
 Added a controls textbox to the Radio scanner
 Added a safeguard to avoid player being locked in elevator (do report if issue still occurs)
 Various minor UI and Map icon fixes
